name: Mypex Core
description: Mypex is an independent voxel game with its own client (not Minecraft). Anarchy mode: a world of floating islands, four bosses at once in the arena with their escorts, map events (a fallen star, a ghost ship), wings for flight, a PvP pit, eight crafting stations, gear enhancements and in-game voice chat. 15 interface languages. Play right in your browser, no install: play.mypex.net . Vote reward: 5000 coins and a case.
